question: To whom may this Kaula teaching be given and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: This Kaula teaching may be given to the worthy
It must not be given indiscriminately
Giving to just anyone is prohibited
inference: This Kaula teaching should be transmitted only to the worthy and withheld from all others.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy, not to just anyone.
